item.fluid.baton.tooltip.summary: Used to configure interaction points for Mechanical Arms and Pipettes
item.fluid.baton.tooltip.action1: Select target and enter configuration mode
item.fluid.baton.tooltip.action2: Add interaction point and cycle mode
block.fluid.fluid_interface.tooltip.summ: A _proxy_ block for interfacing with adjacent fluid containers. Can be used to provide _precise positioning_ for automated fluid handling.
block.fluid.fluid_interface.tooltip.beha: Enables _Mechanical Pipettes_ and other automation to interact with the attached container through the interface.
Allows _direct fluid interaction_ with the attached container using buckets or fluid containers.
block.fluid.smart_fluid_interface.toolti: An _advanced proxy_ block for fluid containers with built-in _filtering capabilities_. Restricts which fluids can pass through.
Only allows _specified fluids_ to be inserted or extracted. Mechanical Pipettes will respect the filter settings.
Functions as a _filtered gateway_ to the attached container, preventing unwanted fluid types.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.summary: A _kinetic device_ for automated fluid transfer between containers. The fluid equivalent of the Mechanical Arm.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour1: _Automatically transfers fluids_ between configured input and output points. Supports _multiple interaction points_ and _selection modes_.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour2: Can _feed lava to Blaze Burners_ automatically and _extract honey from Beehives_ when they're full. Respects _Smart Fluid Interface filters_.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour3: Use the Pipette on _Fluid Interfaces_, _Basins_, _Beehives_, or _Blaze Burners_ to set up interaction points. Use _Wrench_ to modify selection modes.

create.fluid.mechanical_pipette.no_targe: It appears this _Mechanical_ _Pipette_ has not been assigned any _targets._ Select belts, depots, funnels and other blocks by _right-clicking_ them while _holding_ the _Mechanical_ _Pipette_ in your _hand_.
create.hint.mechanical_arm_no_targets: It appears this _Mechanical_ _Arm_ has not been assigned any _targets._ Select belts, depots, funnels and other blocks by _right-clicking_ them while _holding_ the _Mechanical_ _Arm_ in your _hand_.
